items.title: IBIS STYLES KOTA KINABALU INANAM: A STYLISH URBAN ESCAPE AND STRATEGIC GATEWAY TO SABAH
items.content:
Photo credit:  ibis Styles Kota Kinabalu Inanam

Set against the lush green backdrop of Sabah’s rolling hills, ibis Styles Kota Kinabalu Inanam offers travellers a refreshing blend of comfort, creativity, and contemporary design in the thriving township of Inanam, Kota Kinabalu. Conveniently located within the vibrant Taipan Inanam commercial area, surrounded by shoplots, banks, eateries, entertainment outlets, industrial zones, close proximity to education hubs, government administration complexes, the hotel provides unmatched accessibility for both business and leisure travellers. 

Photo credit: ibis Styles Kota Kinabalu Inanam

Photo credit: ibis Styles Kota Kinabalu Inanam

As Kota Kinabalu’s first internationally branded industrial rustic-inspired hotel, ibis Styles Kota Kinabalu Inanam stands out with its bold architecture, modern interiors, and welcoming atmosphere. Designed for modern travellers, the hotel features 184 stylish guest rooms equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi, Sweet Beds by ibis Styles, contemporary amenities, and calming industrial chic interiors. Room categories ranging from Superior Queen and Twin to spacious Superior Suites cater perfectly to solo travellers, families, and corporate guests alike.

Dining experiences at the hotel are equally appealing. Gabion Bistro serves all-day international and local cuisine alongside hearty buffet breakfasts, while ReBAR offers a relaxed environment for evening gatherings. Guests can also unwind at the rooftop SkyDex, enjoying panoramic views of Kota Kinabalu’s skyline, surrounding greenery, and Sabah’s stunning sunsets. 

Photo credit: ibis Styles Kota Kinabalu Inanam

Strategically positioned approximately 20 minutes away from Kota Kinabalu International Airport (KKIA) as well as to Kota Kinabalu city centre and Borneo's largest purpose-built, multi-function waterfront complex, Sabah International Convention Centre (SICC), the hotel offers convenient proximity to major hospitals, education hubs, shopping malls, and key business districts. Its location also provides short travel distances to Sabah’s iconic landmarks and attractions, including Menara Tun Mustapha, Masjid Bandaraya Kota Kinabalu (floating mosque), Mari-Mari Cultural Village, Kokol Hill, Kiulu White Water Rafting, Mount Kinabalu, Kundasang, Mantanani Island access points, and Simpang Mengayau, Kudat—fondly known as the Tip of Borneo.

Photo credit: ibis Styles Kota Kinabalu Inanam

With the newly upgraded road network directly in front of the hotel seamlessly connecting to the Pan Borneo Highway, ibis Styles Kota Kinabalu offers effortless access to Sabah’s northern and eastern corridors, making travel to destinations such as Ranau, Sandakan, Kudat, and beyond more efficient than ever.

Beyond accommodation, the hotel also caters to corporate meetings, government functions, social events, and lifestyle gatherings with versatile meeting spaces and attentive hospitality. Whether visiting for business, educational purposes, adventure tourism, or a relaxing getaway, ibis Styles Kota Kinabalu serves as more than just a stylish urban retreat, it is a strategic gateway to the very best of Sabah.

ibis Styles Kota Kinabalu, Stay Stylish, Stay Connected, and Discover Sabah with Ease.

items.title: A GLIMPSE INTO LIFE AT FOUR POINTS KUALA LUMPUR
items.content:
The experience starts the moment you step into the reimagined comfort of the City Centre. 

You leave the busy streets behind for a space that feels honest and uncomplicated. 

For the family traveller or the urban explorer, everything you need is exactly where it should be. 

Sunlight pours through floor-to-ceiling windows, illuminating a sanctuary of minimalist calm. 

It is a place that values your time as much as your comfort. 


Photo credit: Four Points
A TABLE FOR THE FAMILY

As the morning light fills The Mesh, families gather for a breakfast that feels like home but better. 

This is the social heart of the hotel, where local flavours and international comfort meet. 

The lobby hums with a quiet, social rhythm that invites you to linger. 

As the day unfolds, the dining story expands to the bold spices of Sichuan Kitchen or relaxed bites at the H2O Bar & Grill. 

Whether it’s a quick coffee before exploring or a full family dinner using your daily dining credit, the focus is always on good food and great company.


Photo credit: Four Points

FINDING THE JOY

The hotel is designed to be more than just a stay; it’s an escape for all ages. 

Evenings here are defined by a seamless transition from work to play. 

The outdoor pool area serves as the ultimate urban playground, where kids can splash while parents take in the skyline views. 

Through the M Passport program, little explorers are kept busy with curated activities, turning a simple staycation into a memorable adventure. 

It’s about finding those moments of calm and play amid the city’s fast pace.

 Photo credit: Four Points 

A SPACE TO CALL HOME

Inside the rooms, the focus is on genuine comfort and intelligent space. 

The Family Suites are a standout, offering spacious connecting units with dedicated themed bedrooms that capture a child’s imagination. 

Every detail, from the cosy bedding to the special welcome amenities, is designed to make the transition from travelling to relaxing instant. 

It is a functional, stylish sanctuary that ensures every member of the family has the room they need to breathe.

Photo credit: Four Points

AT THE CENTER OF IT ALL

The beauty of the Four Points location is its proximity to the best of Kuala Lumpur.

Guests are positioned perfectly to explore the city’s iconic landmarks or navigate the nearby business districts. 

You are never more than a few steps away from the city's best hidden gems and culinary treasures.

It’s the ideal middle ground—offering the perks of the Marriott Bonvoy program and easy access to the city's energy, all while providing a comfortable base to return to at the end of the day.

Photo credit: Four Points

Escape and create unforgettable memories.

items.title: A FRONT-ROW SEAT TO THE RENAISSANCE: WHY KL FAMILY STAYS ARE CHANGING
items.content:
We all know the struggle of the typical "city stay" with the family. 

It starts with logistics: how far is the hotel from the LRT? Is there a place nearby where they can run around that isn’t a busy road? By the time you’ve ticked off the convenience boxes, you often find yourself sacrificing the feeling of an actual getaway.

But as we look toward 2026 in Kuala Lumpur, there’s one landmark that has quietly solved that riddle, recently being honoured as Asia's Best Family City Hotel


Photo credit:Renaissance Kuala Lumpur

The Renaissance Kuala Lumpur Hotel & Convention Centre has managed to do something rare in downtown KL by creating a space that portrays itself not just as a hotel, but as a dual-branded urban resort where families can set up their "home base" right in the heart of the action.

                                                                              
Photo credit:Renaissance Kuala Lumpur

The Skyline View is Their Storyteller

When we talk about an "unforgettable stay" in 2026, the experience starts before you even unpack. For a child, seeing the city from the floor-to-ceiling windows of their room isn't just a view; it’s a fairy tale of scale.

The unique perspective here places you in a living conversation between KL’s iconic past and its soaring future. Waking up to the KL Tower on one side and the stunning geometry of the brand-new Merdeka 118 on the other frames their entire stay. 

In 2026, those specific rooms offer the best front-row seat to the changing city they will one day read about in history books.

                                                                

13,000 Square Feet of "Unforgettable"

The real portrait of a Renaissance family is painted on Level 4. You wouldn’t expect to find Paradise Trails tucked between skyscrapers—a 13,000-square-foot outdoor adventure zone dedicated entirely to play.

Photo credit:Renaissance Kuala Lumpur


Here, "unforgettable" looks like this:

  • The Canopy Walk: A chance to walk among the "tops" of the palms, right above the city.


Photo credit:Renaissance Kuala Lumpur

  • The Climbing Wall: Safe, outdoor challenges designed to help them find their confidence.


Photo credit:Renaissance Kuala Lumpur

  • The Massive Pool: One of the largest outdoor pools in the city, complete with water slides that turn a morning dip into a mini-theme park adventure.


Photo credit:Renaissance Kuala Lumpur

While the little ones explore their private sanctuary, parents can actually relax at the Mandara Spa or enjoy a "Bar Ritual" at R Bar, knowing their children are making memories just a few steps away.


Photo credit:Renaissance Kuala Lumpur

Festive Traditions, Reinvented for 2026

If you are planning your 2026 around the holidays, the Renaissance is offering a way to drop the holiday stress and keep the magic.

When you book your stay on Christmas Eve or New Year’s Eve, the portrait changes from adventure to celebration. 

It starts with the exclusive "wake up to the skyline" morning, followed by an Evolution breakfast where the authentic Italian coastal flavours meet the local festive spirit. 

For the Eve of the celebration, the family-friendly Holiday Buffet ensures that everyone—from the most adventurous eater to the pickiest toddler—finds a feast they love.


In 2026...

A family staying here isn't just about finding a room near the Twin Towers.

It’s about securing a place where your family can breathe, play, and watch the future rise right outside your window.

So, what are you waiting for? Book your stay now!

items.title: I LITE U: WHY BUKIT BINTANG’S NEWEST URBAN GLOW IS A PERMANENT MUST-SEE
items.content:
If you think you’ve seen Bukit Bintang at night, think again, because the capital just got a serious glow-up.

Forget the standard street lamps; we’re talking about I LITE U, a massive urban lighting project that has officially turned our golden triangle into a 1-kilometre neon wonderland.

Photo credit: Tourism Malaysia's FB

Launched as a cornerstone of the Visit Malaysia 2026 campaign, this isn't just a temporary festival; it’s a permanent upgrade to the city's nightlife identity.

Photo credit: Tourism Malaysia's FB

The name I LITE U stands for Infrastructure, Lighting, Innovation, Technology, and Eco-Sustainability towards Urbanisation.

Stretching from Pavilion Kuala Lumpur all the way to the Federal Hotel, the project features over 70 energy-efficient LED installations that are as smart as they are beautiful.

Photo credit: Tourism Malaysia's FB

You’ll find everything from "moon lamps" and hanging chandeliers to fairytale-themed designs that make the concrete jungle feel like a high-tech forest.

But here’s the real tea: beyond the gorgeous selfies, this urban glow-up is actually a massive win for anyone walking the streets at night.

Between us, while the lights look incredible on your feed, the real magic is how they make the city feel "Happy, Safe, and Liveable" by boosting visibility along the busiest stretch in town.

The upgraded pedestrian crossings are now brighter and safer, making that midnight stroll for late-night shawarma a lot more comfortable for solo travellers.

Because it uses sustainable LED technology, it also aligns with KL's low-carbon city goals, meaning you can enjoy the "City of Lights" vibe with a lot less guilt about the environment.

Photo credit: Tourism Malaysia's FB

Whether you are here for the shopping at Pavilion or the street food at Jalan Alor, the "Warm White Celebration of Light" concept ensures the vibe is always festive, no matter what month it is.

So, when you find yourself in the heart of the city, look up, grab your camera, and enjoy the glow. It’s officially the brightest way to experience KL.

Quick Summary

  • Location: Spanning 1km along Jalan Bukit Bintang (from Pavilion KL to Federal Hotel).

  • Cost: Free for everyone; it’s a public infrastructure project.

  • Best Time to Visit: Daily from 7:00 PM onwards for the full illumination effect.

  • The Vibe: Futuristic, safe, and highly photogenic.

Have you had a chance to walk through the new I LITE U stretch yet? Which of the 70 light installations is your favourite for a quick snap?

items.title: BUKIT BINTANG GLOW UP: YOUR GUIDE TO THE DAZZLING "I LITE U" PARADE!
items.content:
If you thought Bukit Bintang was already bright enough to be seen from space, get ready because things are about to get even glowier.

Photo credit: Tourism Malaysia's FB

Kuala Lumpur is officially kicking off the countdown to Visit Malaysia 2026 (VM2026) with a massive, neon-soaked celebration called "I Lite U @ Bukit Bintang."

The heart of the city is transforming into a massive open-air stage, and trust us, you’ll want your camera fully charged for this one.

Starting January 3rd, 2026, the famous shopping strip will be decked out in cascades of light and vibrant festive gantries that make for the ultimate selfie backdrop.

But the real showstopper is the grand parade, featuring over 700 performers including marching bands, stilt walkers, and even flash mobs!

Keep an eye out for cultural highlights like lion and dragon dances, bhangra, and traditional Orang Asli performances that showcase the true soul of Malaysia.

The parade kicks off near Starhill and Pavilion KL, winding its way down to the Federal Hotel side near Plaza Low Yat.

Photo credit: Tourism Malaysia's FB

If you’re a bit of a shutterbug, there’s even a VMY2026 Kuala Lumpur Competition running until March 10th with prizes up to RM5,000 in vouchers for the best photos and videos.

Now, a tiny bit of "friend-to-friend" advice: expect some crowds, as nearly one million people are expected to join the festivities!

To keep your stress levels low, DBKL will be closing Jalan Bukit Bintang and Jalan Sultan Ismail on launch day from 6:00 pm to midnight.

Our pro tip? Skip the grab and hop on the MRT or LRT. There are even requests to extend rail services just for this event.

So, grab your most comfortable walking shoes, head down to the city centre, and let’s welcome the road to 2026 with a bang!


Quick Summary:

  • The Event: I Lite U @ Bukit Bintang (A prelude to Visit Malaysia 2026).

  • Key Date: Launching January 3rd, 2026.

  • Location: Jalan Bukit Bintang (From Pavilion KL to Federal Hotel).

  • Road Closures: Jalan Bukit Bintang & Jalan Sultan Ismail (6pm – Midnight on launch day).

  • The Competition: Capture the lights for a chance to win RM5,000 in vouchers (ends March 10th, 2026).

  • Top Tip: Use public transport to avoid the gridlock!

Are you planning to join the parade, or would you rather find a rooftop bar nearby to watch the lights from above?

items.title: TASTE THE ESSENCE OF FORTUNE: THE IMPERIAL PROSPERITY FEAST AT CELESTIAL COURT
items.content:
Sheraton Imperial Kuala Lumpur Hotel invites diners to celebrate the Lunar New Year with a masterful display of elegance and tradition at its signature Cantonese restaurant, Celestial Court.

Located in the bustling heart of the city, this renowned venue takes centre stage this season with the Imperial Prosperity menu, a creative culinary highlight curated specifically for the Year of the Horse.

Photo credit: Sheraton Imperial Kuala Lumpur Hotel

This curated dining experience thoughtfully reimagines heritage and abundance, blending time-honoured traditions with contemporary flair to honour the spirit of renewal.

The celebration begins with the vibrant Prosperity Yee Sang, a symbolic toss featuring premium sliced abalone, sea jellyfish, and refreshing snow pear drizzled in a traditional plum sauce.

Photo credit: Sheraton Imperial Kuala Lumpur Hotel

Guests can indulge in the luxurious Braised Premium Treasures Soup with dried seafood, a dish designed to represent the blessings of longevity and harmony.

A centrepiece of the feast is the Braised Whole Baby Abalone, an opulent creation featuring dried scallops, sea cucumber, fish maw, and dried oysters.

Photo credit: Sheraton Imperial Kuala Lumpur Hotel

The restaurant's culinary team also presents signature highlights such as the roasted crispy duck infused with herbs and the steamed tiger grouper paired with red-eye chilli and fungus flower.

Photo credit: Sheraton Imperial Kuala Lumpur Hotel

To complement the savoury courses, the roasted garlic fried rice with diced scallops and asparagus offers a flavourful transition to the sweet conclusion of the meal.

The dining experience concludes on a refreshing note with chilled herbs jelly with sea coconut and red dates, alongside cold ice cream mochi and fine Long Jing tea.

Photo credit: Sheraton Imperial Kuala Lumpur Hotel

Beyond the set menus, Celestial Court has introduced its Supreme Spicy Sun-Dried Scallop Sauce, a handcrafted condiment made with Japanese scallops, dried shrimps, and chilli padi.

This premium, pork-free sauce is free from preservatives and alcohol, making it a distinguished gift for corporate partners or a flavorful addition to family reunions.

To accommodate these cherished gatherings, the restaurant offers five private dining spaces, including the grand Pearl Room, which comfortably seats up to 30 guests.

For more intimate or exclusive reunions, the Ruby Room provides a quiet VIP space for 15, while the Jade Rooms and Crystal Room offer modern settings for smaller groups.

These sought-after spaces provide personalised service and a warm, refined atmosphere, ensuring every festive gathering is both meaningful and memorable.

Diners are encouraged to gallop confidently into the Year of the Horse by securing a table for this season of prosperity and happiness.

Photo credit: Sheraton Imperial Kuala Lumpur Hotel

Celebrate the Season, Book Today

Gather for a memorable reunion and savour the Imperial Prosperity menu at Celestial Court. With popular private rooms and festive menus in high demand, early reservations are recommended to ensure a delicious start to the Year of the Horse.

items.title: THE POWER PARTNERSHIP: EARN AIRASIA POINTS EVERY TIME YOU SHOP AT SUNGEI WANG PLAZA
items.content:
Sungei Wang Plaza has officially joined forces with AirAsia rewards in an exciting partnership that allows shoppers to earn points across the mall’s entire retail, dining, and lifestyle ecosystem.

Photo credit: Sungei Wang Plaza

This collaboration transforms every ringgit spent into valuable AirAsia points that can be redeemed for flights, hotel stays, and more.

​Whether you are enjoying a quick bite or making a major fashion purchase, your daily spending now carries the extra value of travel rewards.

Photo credit: Sungei Wang Plaza

​To start earning, simply scan the QR code displayed at any outlet, upload your receipt, and submit the email registered with your AirAsia MOVE app.

​Exclusive International Tourist Rewards

​In anticipation of Visit Malaysia Year 2026, the mall has also unveiled its International Tourist Reward Campaign specifically for global travellers.

Photo credit: Sungei Wang Plaza

​Visitors can kickstart their adventure at the Ground Floor Information Counter by registering for an Exclusive Tourist Postcard and receiving 500 Free AirAsia Welcome Points.

​The postcard acts as a curated map, guiding you through the mall's hidden gems, from nostalgic photo spots to local creative brands.

Photo credit: Sungei Wang Plaza

​As you explore, you can collect official stamps from designated checkpoints to turn your shopping trip into a fun, interactive journey.

Photo credit: Sungei Wang Plaza

To help you navigate the wider neighbourhood, the mall also offers a new pocket-friendly Kuala Lumpur City Map at the information counter. 

​Limited-Edition Redemptions

​Travellers can commemorate their visit by redeeming a limited-edition Sungei Wang Plaza x Loka Made Tote Bag, featuring artwork inspired by Kuala Lumpur.

Photo credit: Sungei Wang Plaza

You can claim this bag by spending a minimum of RM150 in a maximum of two receipts at any outlet within the plaza.

​Alternatively, you can collect all postcard stamps and make a smaller total spend of RM80 in up to two receipts to secure your tote bag.

​Redemptions are available at the Information Counter on a first-come, first-served basis, so be sure to head there early.

​A Legacy of Experiences

​Since opening in 1977, Sungei Wang Plaza has remained a beauty-focused experiential hub and an iconic shopping landmark in Bukit Bintang.

​With major anchors like Mega Star Arena and Blastacars, the mall offers unconventional experiences that captivate both new generations and loyal visitors.

​As the plaza approaches its Golden Anniversary in 2027, it continues to redefine retail through innovation and community engagement.

​Visit the Sungei Wang Plaza Information Counter today to register for your rewards and make your shopping experience truly travel-worthy!

For more information, visit Sungei Wang Plaza’s website at www.sungeiwang.com or check real-time updates on Sungei Wang’s Facebook page at www.facebook.com/sungeiwangplaza.
